title: Two-Stage Probabilistic 3D Reconstruction of Underwater Objects via Range-Adaptive Sonar and Optical Fusion in Turbid Environments
authors: Jason Kim; Geonwoo Park; Seong-min Park; Seungmin Kim; Son-Cheol Yu
venue: International Journal of Control, Automation, and Systems 24, 1083-1101
venue_group: Springer Nature / International Journal of Control, Automation, and Systems
matched_query: range-adaptive sonar optical fusion probabilistic underwater 3D reconstruction turbid environments
reasons: probabilistic 3D reconstruction from forward-looking sonar and stereo vision
authoritative metadata verified from Springer Nature
summary_en: A two-stage probabilistic reconstruction method that first builds a volumetric occupancy prior from forward-looking sonar and then refines it with stereo-optical constraints when the target enters visual range. The method explicitly models sonar elevation ambiguity, occlusion, and partial optical visibility.
